title: Story premise ENT067: The Ten Squares in the Window
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (perception and hidden objects). Hook: The sign says ten. Count the glass yourself. Takeaway/theme: Check what is being counted, including duplicates and larger shapes.
description: A window cleaner must count every square in a 2-by-2 square window, but the label demanding TEN is wrong. They outline the four small squares and the single large square, replace TEN with FIVE, and reveal that the boss had accidentally counted the same window’s reflection too.
